description: Encoded PowerShell launched by an Office application.

queryCondition.queryText: DeviceProcessEvents | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ('winword.exe','excel.exe','outlook.exe') | where FileName == 'powershell.exe' | where ProcessCommandLine has '-enc'

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious encoded PowerShell from Office
alertTemplate.description: An Office app launched an encoded PowerShell command.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Investigate the parent document and the user's recent email.
